package practiceruntime

import (
	"context"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

type projectionTransport func(*http.Request) (*http.Response, error)

func (f projectionTransport) RoundTrip(r *http.Request) (*http.Response, error) { return f(r) }
func TestExecutionProjectionHTTPContract(t *testing.T) {
	for _, c := range []struct {
		name, body string
		status     int
		fail       bool
	}{{"valid", `{"schema":"practice-execution-projection.v1","status":"BLOCKED","available_actions":[],"reason_code":"validation_running","version":"v1"}`, 200, false}, {"unknown_field", `{"schema":"practice-execution-projection.v1","answer_key":"secret"}`, 200, true}, {"oversized", strings.Repeat("x", 32769), 200, true}, {"trailing", `{} {}`, 200, true}, {"failure", `{}`, 503, true}} {
		t.Run(c.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			client := &http.Client{Transport: projectionTransport(func(r *http.Request) (*http.Response, error) {
				if r.URL.Path != "/internal/v2/task-instances/instance/execution-projection" || r.URL.Query().Get("student_id") != "student" || r.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token") != "runtime-token" {
					t.Error("wrong owner request")
				}
				return &http.Response{StatusCode: c.status, Body: io.NopCloser(strings.NewReader(c.body))}, nil
			})}
			_, err := (Client{BaseURL: "http://runtime.test", InternalToken: "runtime-token", HTTPClient: client}).ReadExecutionProjection(context.Background(), "student", "instance")
			if (err != nil) != c.fail {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
		})
	}
}
